player_prompt.intro:
U ngwe Player {player_id} wa ku tlhela Checkers eka {color}.
Tlhela nkayelo wa wena hi notation ya chess-style [fileRank fileRank], k.g. '[b2c3]' (lemba ra kolomisi a–h, digiti ya safu 0–7).
Mintsho ya ndzima:
  • Tlhela emahlweni hi ku ya ematshan'wini hi ku ngana ku va khali.
  • Tlhela hi ku kula nkayelo wa mpfana wa wena.
  • Nkayelo iya kulekisa loko i fika ematshan'wini wa mpfana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hakuna muako wa nkayelo lowu vekiwile. Usa [a1b2], k.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Vuhlalu byo tshwuka byi hava swiphemu. Vantima va hlula!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Vantima a va ha ri na swiphemu, lavo tshwuka hi vona lava hlulaka!
outcome.no_moves: Mutlangi {player_id} a nga ha ri na ku famba.
outcome.draw: Mpimo wa ku jikela wu fikeleriwile.
